ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. went
   C. goes
   D. goed

2. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the Library

3. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.

4. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.

5. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only a joining word
   D. Only an action

6. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.

7. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.

8. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.

9. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. run
   C. quickly
   D. blue

10. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.

11. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.

12. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. No full stops

13. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.

14. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Language Activities at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
